Doses of 5 mg of solifenacin succinate once daily by mouth are recom- mended in patients with moderate hepatic impairment (Child- Pugh category B) or severe renal impairment (creatinine clear- ance less than 30 mL/minute). It should not be used in patients with severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh category C) or in those undergoing haemodialysis.
